title: The Gold Patron
subtitle: One half of an exclusive pair
description: Two patrons share an `exclusiveGroup`, which is a pact between siblings: completing one locks the other for good. Take the gold patron's coin and the silver patron's door closes; the pair is a choice of paths, not a checklist.
Exclusivity is scoped to the chapter, and the ledger below is written to survive it — its prerequisite mode asks for one completed dependency, so either coin closes the book.
